whatIsSection.title: Dubai South Free Zone Explained
paragraphs: Dubai South Free Zone is a fully government-supported economic area located in the southern end of Dubai, next to the world's largest airport. It offers a simplified legal and regulatory framework for local and international businesses.
Entrepreneurs benefit from full repatriation of profits, no income and corporate taxes, and flexible packages for startups, SMEs, and multinational corporations.

items.q: What is Dubai South Free Zone and why is it ideal for company formation?
items.a: Dubai South Free Zone is a government-backed economic zone next to Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo 2020 site. It supports logistics, e-commerce, aviation, and trade with 100% foreign ownership, zero taxes, and world-class infrastructure.

items.q: What are the key benefits of setting up in Dubai South Free Zone?
items.a: 100% foreign ownership, zero personal and corporate income tax, fast registration (2-4 days), flexible packages for all business sizes, and a complete startup ecosystem.

items.q: Which business activities are allowed in Dubai South Free Zone?
items.a: Logistics, aviation services, e-commerce, trade, consulting, IT services, digital platforms, and more. The complete list is available on the official Dubai South website.

items.q: Do I need a local sponsor to start a company in Dubai South Free Zone?
items.a: No. Dubai South Free Zone allows 100% foreign ownership — you do not need a local sponsor to set up or operate your business.

items.q: What types of licenses are available?
items.a: Commercial, Service, and Industrial licenses depending on your business activity. Each has different visa quotas and office requirements.
Free Zone Establishment (FZE) for single shareholders, Free Zone Company (FZCO) for multiple shareholders, and Branch Offices for existing UAE or foreign companies.

items.q: Can I set up a Dubai South Free Zone company remotely?
items.a: Yes. We handle the entire process remotely — from document collection to license issuance — no need to visit Dubai.

items.q: What are the visa options after setting up?
items.a: You can apply for residency visas for yourself, family, and employees. Visa quotas depend on your office size (flexi desk or private office).
